captions.text: Welcome to Whitebox Academy. This is the first chapter, so here's where we're going.
First, you'll learn the Python you need. No AI experience is required.
Then you'll build an agent, and turn it into your own framework.
Finally, you'll build a coding agent that fixes bugs on its own.
Today's black box: the tools on your own computer.
Let's open it.

scenes.title: What you need
flow: Ollama runs AI models on your computer
qwen2.5:7b is the model we use

captions.text: You need three tools. First, Python 3.12 or newer.
Second, Ollama, a small server that runs AI models on your own computer for free.
Third, the model itself, about a 4.7 GB download.
You don't need an account or an API key yet. Install steps are in the article.
Ollama must be running whenever you use a model. If it isn't, you'll see this error.
Start it by opening the Ollama app, or by running ollama serve in a separate terminal.
Check it with ollama list. You may need to start it again after restarting your computer.
Once they're installed, run the setup check from the chapter folder.
It checks Python, your disk space and your memory.
Then it checks Ollama and that the model is installed.
Finally, it asks the model two small questions, including one that needs a tool.
You're ready when the last line says 7/7 passed.
If a check fails, it tells you what to do. Here, Ollama isn't running.
Fix the first FAIL line, then run the check again.
SKIP means a check can't run until that failure is fixed.
That's all the setup you need for now.
Next, you'll start learning Python.
